name: Project Netrunner v 0.35 Gameplay Demo
author: norad89
description:
This is the latest version of Project Netrunner, a simple infinite runner game. Use the spacebar to jump, double jump or dash forward, showcasing your agility and reflexes.
This demo focuses on providing a basic gameplay experience while demonstrating data persistence between scenes, allowing you to keep your progress during the same play.
For an immersive experience, don't forget to enable the sound. Although it's a demo with limited features, it serves as a professional showcase of the core mechanics.
